authority_basis: AD-20260806-002 accepted canonical recursive runtime structure
AD-20260805-001 portal supersedes gate as identity level eight

composition_law.child_relationship: direct composition by stable identity reference
composition_law.canonical_substance_rule: canonical child substance exists once and is never copied into the parent
composition_law.emergence_rule: a parent qualifies only when the composition produces the tier-specific emergent property absent from every child alone
composition_law.promotion_rule: size, file count, path depth, age, popularity, and anticipated reuse never establish tier
composition_law.incomplete_rule: an element with fewer than two qualifying children may exist only as template, proposal, compatibility surface, or incomplete candidate and must not claim substantiated tier status
composition_law.succession_rule: replacement creates a successor with lineage; accepted identity is not silently rewritten

universal_instance_criteria: direct child references with no duplicated substance

tiers.name: iota
tiers.essence: The smallest identity-bearing canonical unit whose removal or division changes meaning.
tiers.scope: One indivisible semantic assertion, datum, tokenized rule, reference, parameter, or operation.
must: possess a stable identity independent of path
carry one authoritative semantic responsibility
be indivisible without semantic loss or authority ambiguity
declare type, value or operation, authority state, lineage, provenance, and compatibility
be independently referenceable and reusable
contain no lower identity-tier instances
expose deterministic serialization or canonical representation
fail closed when its meaning, authority, or type is unresolved
remain immutable in identity; changes supersede rather than silently mutate meaning
must_not: pretend a file, field, byte, character, or AST node is automatically an iota
tiers.proof: A reviewer can state its complete meaning in one unambiguous sentence and cannot split it into two independently reusable identity-bearing units without changing that meaning.

tiers.name: mote
tiers.essence: The smallest coherent micro-capability, formed from multiple iotas whose interaction produces one usable effect.
tiers.scope: One bounded micro-function, predicate, transform, binding, invariant, or typed relation.
must: compose at least two distinct active iota instances
produce one coherent effect not supplied by any constituent iota alone
define input, output, preconditions, postconditions, and failure semantics where executable
preserve direct references to constituent iotas rather than copying their substance
expose deterministic composition order or explicitly commutative composition
remain independently testable and reusable
declare internal dependency direction and reject cycles unless a higher authority explicitly permits a fixed point
emit or support evidence sufficient to prove its micro-capability
remain narrower than an observable enduring property
must_not: claim a stable behavioral characteristic that belongs at trait level
tiers.proof: Removing any required iota breaks the micro-capability, while the remaining composition still cannot be reclassified as the same mote.

tiers.name: trait
tiers.essence: A stable, observable property produced by multiple motes and consistently expressed across applicable contexts.
tiers.scope: One durable quality, guarantee, tendency, constraint, interface property, or measurable characteristic.
must: compose at least two distinct active mote instances
express one stable property observable through a declared surface
define the contexts in which the property is guaranteed and those in which it is inapplicable
include measurable acceptance conditions
remain stable across repeated executions with equivalent inputs and authority state
declare conflicts and precedence among constituent motes
preserve constituent identity and provenance
support property-level validation rather than example-only validation
remain non-orchestrating and narrower than a conditional behavioral pattern
must_not: collapse multiple unrelated properties into one trait
tiers.proof: The property is observable and testable across more than one valid context, and no single mote alone guarantees it.

tiers.name: quirk
tiers.essence: A bounded conditional behavioral pattern formed from multiple traits, distinctive in when or how it manifests.
tiers.scope: One trigger-governed behavior, strategy, policy reaction, adaptation, exception pattern, or specialized mode of response.
must: compose at least two distinct active trait instances
declare trigger, guard, context, behavior, termination, and fallback
produce a behavior distinguishable from each constituent trait
remain bounded to one behavioral concern
declare state requirements and side-effect boundaries
be replayable or explicitly classify irreproducible external effects
expose deterministic precedence when multiple quirks are simultaneously eligible
preserve the traits as reusable references
support focused behavioral tests including non-trigger cases
must_not: own unrelated persistence, scheduling, and communication concerns
tiers.proof: Given the same authoritative context and trigger, the quirk selects and executes the same bounded behavior, while disabling it leaves the parent capability otherwise structurally intact.

tiers.name: prodigal
tiers.essence: An autonomous reusable capability assembled from multiple quirks and governed by a stable public contract.
tiers.scope: One independently invocable job, engine, subsystem capability, workflow, processor, planner, compiler, resolver, or service-like function.
must: compose at least two distinct active quirk instances
own one coherent capability contract with declared inputs, outputs, errors, and compatibility
coordinate its quirks without absorbing their independent identity
be independently invocable, testable, replaceable by compatible succession, and reusable
declare operational state, resources, dependencies, and failure containment
own its Rubric when it has executable implementation
emit receipts for durable actions
expose extension points through slots, attachments, moods, adapters, or typed Segues
remain subordinate to exactly one primary Exile semantic owner while permitting Kindred relations elsewhere
must_not: hide consumer-specific coupling behind a generic name
be promoted solely because it has many files
tiers.proof: It can be invoked through its contract as a complete capability, and its removal disables one capability without erasing the parent Exile's identity or all of its responsibilities.

tiers.name: exile
tiers.essence: A domain-responsible semantic owner composed of multiple Prodigals and accountable for one enduring operational concern.
tiers.scope: One named owner of a durable concern such as orchestration, evidence, mutation, contracts, composition, normalization, decomposition, conversation, or communication.
must: compose at least two distinct active prodigal instances
own one durable semantic jurisdiction that remains meaningful independent of implementation
define explicit boundaries, responsibilities, non-responsibilities, and collaboration contracts
possess stable identity, authority, lineage, provenance, dependencies, dependents, and compatibility
own all Rubrics whose primary meaning belongs to its jurisdiction
consume Cabals only where shared qualification is proven
coordinate Prodigals without duplicating their capability substance
participate in Kindred through typed relations rather than informal coupling
remain composable into an Innate without becoming a global root or universal utility
must_not: be a folder, namespace, team label, or arbitrary collection
contain generic shared code merely for convenience
derive ownership from filename or path
tiers.proof: Its jurisdiction can be stated as one enduring responsibility; every owned Prodigal materially serves that responsibility; moving a Prodigal elsewhere requires an explicit authority and dependency rationale.

tiers.name: innate
tiers.essence: A constitutional faculty composed of multiple Exiles whose coordinated jurisdictions provide one intrinsic system ability.
tiers.scope: One fundamental capability family that the containing Portal inherently possesses.
must: compose at least two distinct active exile instances
express one intrinsic faculty broader than any constituent Exile jurisdiction
define the constitutional guarantees the faculty provides to its Portal
govern collaboration and conflict resolution among member Exiles
declare admission criteria for Exiles and reject merely adjacent concerns
expose a stable faculty contract to the enclosing Portal
preserve Exile autonomy and ownership
provide fault-containment boundaries preventing one Exile failure from silently corrupting siblings
remain independent of any one external entry channel
must_not: directly absorb Prodigals except through an explicitly modeled compatibility bridge
represent an external boundary or entry surface
tiers.proof: The faculty remains conceptually valid when any one Exile is replaced by a compatible successor, but ceases to be substantiated if it lacks plural complementary jurisdictions.

tiers.name: portal
tiers.essence: A governed interaction boundary composed of multiple Innates, through which capabilities are admitted, exposed, translated, or traversed.
tiers.scope: One coherent ingress, egress, mediation, protocol, audience, environment, or interaction boundary.
must: compose at least two distinct active innate instances
define who or what may cross, in which direction, under which authority, contract, and policy
mediate rather than duplicate the faculties of its Innates
declare protocols, adapters, security boundaries, compatibility, rate or capacity constraints, and failure behavior
provide typed Segues inward to Innates and outward to the Obelisk environment
preserve end-to-end lineage and provenance for traversing payloads
support denial by default at controlled capability boundaries
remain independently observable and testable as a boundary
avoid becoming a programming gate; historical identity Gate paths remain compatibility surfaces only
must_not: be a generic directory named gateway or interface
tiers.proof: A traversal can be validated from admission through mediation to result, with authority and provenance intact, and the Portal remains a boundary rather than a capability owner.

tiers.name: obelisk
tiers.essence: A sovereign fundamental Savant system composed of multiple Portals and responsible for one complete, durable, top-level purpose.
tiers.scope: One major foundational system with its own constitutional purpose, governed boundaries, lifecycle, assurance, and evolution.
must: compose at least two distinct active portal instances
declare one complete top-level purpose that cannot be reduced to a single Portal
govern its Portals through explicit authority, constitutional invariants, and compatibility law
expose stable identity, lifecycle, lineage, provenance, dependencies, dependents, and recovery model
contain all lower identity tiers through recursive composition without duplicating their substance
provide system-level assurance, observability, replay, migration, and succession criteria
remain independently extensible through new Portals and typed Segues
coordinate with other Obelisks through explicit Kindred, Cabal, contract, or Portal relations
avoid claiming Savant-wide authority unless explicitly established by higher constitutional authority
must_not: serve as a dumping ground for unrelated systems
be created because a project is large
tiers.proof: Its purpose, boundaries, Portals, invariants, and failure/recovery model form a coherent sovereign system; removing one Portal degrades access but does not erase the Obelisk's identity.

criterion_mood_pipeline.function: activates identity and verifies that an element is a real instance rather than a path, file, projection, or placeholder
binds distinct child instances into a parent composition while preserving their identities and references
hardens the composition through invariants, validation, replay, regression, and failure testing
attaches optional capabilities, slots, adapters, and extensions without copying or replacing canonical substance
projects and expresses the element through human, machine, diagnostic, and runtime views without creating authority
applies jurisdiction, authority, policy, security, custody, and responsibility boundaries
balances cardinality, cohesion, coupling, symmetry, capacity, and dependency direction
proves that emergence has crossed the threshold into the next distinct tier and prevents false promotion
compiles validated lower-tier composition into higher-order operation and, at runtime, prepares it for deferred shardization

scaffolding.name: recursive identity scaffold
scaffolding.vertical_members: direct composition edges between adjacent tiers
scaffolding.horizontal_members: typed Kindred, dependency, authority, provenance, compatibility, and Cabal relations

established_now: runtime shards are not the superseded second identity level
canonical instances remain authoritative and are not replaced by shards
shards are runtime projections or execution units derived deterministically from canonical instances
every shard must retain source identity, digest, lineage, provenance, authority witness, and replay information
shard format, granularity, lifecycle, routing, recombination, and persistence remain unresolved pending a later accepted decision
